lessons.goal: 整合日期、方向及附註，避免只取醒目時間。

questions.evidence: RIVERSIDE SHUTTLE NOTICE: On festival Saturday, the last bus from the station to Riverside Park leaves at 8:30 p.m. The last bus in the opposite direction, from the park to the station, leaves at 9:10 p.m. These special times apply only on the festival date.
questions.explanation: 公告回程為晚上九點十分。
options: The usual weekday time in every case.
A time set by the event ticket.
questions.prompt: When is the last festival bus from the park to the station?

questions.evidence: Board at the marked shuttle stop beside the park's east entrance. The west entrance has no shuttle stop during the festival because that road is used for performances. A short walk connects the entrances inside the park, but leave enough time to reach the correct stop. Tickets are bought on boarding; an event ticket does not include the shuttle fare.
options: The east entrance.
Both entrances.
Neither entrance.
The west entrance.
questions.prompt: Which entrance has the festival shuttle stop?

questions.evidence: The usual weekday timetable remains unchanged. Visitors should check the direction printed above each column before planning a return trip. The largest time on the poster is not necessarily the departure they need.
questions.explanation: 欄位方向决定時間適用的車程。
options: Every column uses the same route.
The largest number always means the return bus.
Weekday service is canceled forever.
Different directions have different last departures.
questions.prompt: Why must readers check column headings?
